import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { orders } from "../../../backend/schema/orders";

export const ordersCms = customizeTable<typeof orders>("orders", {
    icon: "ShoppingCart",
    listFields: [
        "orderId",
        "shipName",
        "shipAddress",
        "shipCity",
        "shipRegion",
        "shipPostalCode"
    ],
    fieldOrder: [
        "orderId",
        "shipName",
        "shipAddress",
        "shipCity",
        "shipRegion",
        "shipPostalCode",
        "shipCountry",
        "freight",
        "orderDate",
        "requiredDate",
        "shippedDate",
        "customer",
        "employee",
        "shipViaRelation"
    ]
});
